The China Drug Dependency中国药品依赖：欧洲的隐忧

The China Drug Dependency
CFR /2026-10-06 /Tim Rühlig

Europe's pharmaceutical dependence on China runs deeper than finished drugs: for 20 of 56 essential active ingredients China holds enough production to leave patients without alternatives, and chemical building blocks are even more concentrated (over four-fifths of metformin supply is exposed once precursors are counted). The dependency stems from decades of health-system cost containment that squeezed generics margins, while China pursued deliberate industrial policy to absorb the capacity. With US tariffs of up to 100 percent on patented medicines announced in April 2026 and a generics review looming, Europe must decide quickly whether to build resilience alone or with partners.

欧洲对中国药品的依赖远不止成品药：德国列为必需品的56种活性药物成分中，有20种的全球产能集中于中国，一旦中断将无替代来源；若计入化学前体，二甲双胍约八成以上的供应都暴露于中国风险之下。根源在于欧洲医保体系数十年的成本控制挤压了仿制药利润，而中国则以明确的产业政策接手了流出的产能。美国于2026年4月宣布对专利药征收最高100%的关税，仿制药审查也将在一年内到来，欧洲必须尽快决定独自还是联合伙伴构建韧性。

CSIS /2026-10-05 /Shashwat Kumar

The Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act, passed September 18, targets Russian energy revenue but works more as economic statecraft against buyers such as India and China.
